maddeler.e:
ترتهنوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَهِنُوا (tartahinū) /tar.ta.hi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# تُرْتَهَنُوا (turtahanū) /tur.ta.ha.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
